title: USASpending GovCon Incumbent & Recompete Enricher Input

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords / Scope Filter
searchKeywords.description: Keywords, technical capabilities, or solicitation/contract identifiers (e.g., 'zero trust', 'cloud migration', 'cybersecurity', 'DevSecOps'). Leave blank to filter purely by NAICS/Agency.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS Industry Codes
naicsCodes.description: 6-digit NAICS codes to target (e.g., 541511 Custom Computer Programming, 541512 Computer Systems Design, 541519 Other Computer Related Services).

pscCodes.title: Product & Service Codes (PSC)
pscCodes.description: Optional 4-character Federal PSC codes (e.g., 'D302' IT Systems Development, 'D310' Cyber Security and Data Backup).

recipientSearchText.title: Target Incumbent Contractor Name or UEI
recipientSearchText.description: Optional: Filter awards held by a specific incumbent contractor name or 12-character SAM UEI (e.g., 'Booz Allen', 'Leidos', 'J8K2L9M4N1P2').

awardingAgencyName.title: Awarding Toptier Agency Name
awardingAgencyName.description: Optional: Filter by awarding toptier agency name (e.g., 'Department of Defense', 'Department of Homeland Security', 'Department of Veterans Affairs').

awardIds.title: Specific Contract / Award IDs (PIID Crosswalk)
awardIds.description: Optional list of specific contract PIIDs (e.g., 'W911NF26C0001') to cross-walk from SAM.gov notices.

awardTypeGroup.title: Contract Vehicle Type
awardTypeGroup.description: Select Definitive Contracts (A, B, C, D), Indefinite Delivery Vehicles / IDIQs (IDVs), or both.
enumTitles: Definitive Contracts & Purchase Orders (A, B, C, D)

expiringWithinDays.title: Recompete Radar: Expiring Within (Days)
expiringWithinDays.description: Client-side Period-of-Performance End Date filter applied BEFORE charging PPE. Set to e.g. 180 or 365 to only harvest contracts expiring within N days. Set to 0 to disable expiration filtering and harvest all matching awards.

includeRecentlyExpiredDays.title: Include Recently Expired Contracts (Bridge / Transition Window Days)
includeRecentlyExpiredDays.description: When Expiring Within (Days) > 0, also include contracts whose End Date passed within the last N days (captures delayed recompetes and bridge extensions).

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum Award Amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Filter out micro-purchases below this obligated dollar threshold (e.g., 100000 for $100k+ contracts).

maxRecords.title: Maximum Contracts to Harvest (PPE Budget Cap)
maxRecords.description: Hard ceiling on validated contract records pushed to dataset ($0.03 per record).

enrichCompetitionVulnerability.title: Enrich FPDS Competition Vulnerability & Solicitation ID (+$0.02/record)
enrichCompetitionVulnerability.description: When enabled, queries `/api/v2/awards/{generated_internal_id}/` for each matched contract to extract Number of Offers Received, Single-Bid Vulnerability flag, Extent Competed, Set-Aside Type, Potential Award Ceiling, Contracting Office, and SAM.gov Solicitation ID.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings (USASpending API is public and normally requires no proxy).
